_derived_from: wuhan-design-analysis.json + nanjing-chongqing-xiamen-design-analysis.json — the consistent pattern across all 4 supplier references, populated with La Salle's real brand elements per design-theory.md

_pattern_confirmed_across_all_4_referenc.human_figures_present: FALSE in every single example — a hard rule, not a stylistic choice. Our jumping-student silhouettes broke this every version.
_pattern_confirmed_across_all_4_referenc.density_pct_frame_filled: 85-95% in every example — large empty background is the single biggest visible deviation from the house style.
_pattern_confirmed_across_all_4_referenc.delight_element: Exactly ONE per design, large (not a small accent), and usually INTEGRATED WITH the nameplate rather than placed separately.
_pattern_confirmed_across_all_4_referenc.nameplate: Always a shaped, layered, die-cut-style element INTEGRATED INTO another element (a ferris-wheel gondola, a floating fan, a building sign, a record label) — never a free-floating plaque with nothing else around it.

dominant_landmark.element: The curved modern white school building (real, confirmed by school-building-streetview.jpg)

secondary_elements.element: A sports field or basketball/handball court fence line
secondary_elements.role: campus feature — La Salle's real PE culture, seen in the jumping-students photo's court markings

secondary_elements.element: Kowloon residential towers in the far background
secondary_elements.role: grounds the scene in a real Hong Kong location, same role as Chongqing's/Xiamen's distant skyline

secondary_elements.element: Trees along the street (real — visible in school-building-streetview.jpg)

filler_motif.coverage_pct_of_frame: 35-45%, NOT a single thin left-edge branch as attempted in v2-v7 — needs to read as genuine texture the way cherry blossoms/clouds/water do in the references

delight_element.element: THE SWIMMING POOL — reconsidered choice, replacing earlier generic ideas
delight_element.why_this_and_not_something_generic: design-theory.md's own caution was not to force a fake tourism/mascot element onto a school if the formula doesn't fit. A generic school bus or graduation cap would be exactly that. But La Salle genuinely has its own indoor competitive pool with red/blue lane markers and a 'We Are The CHAMPION' banner (real, confirmed by school-pool-banner.jpg) — that IS this school's real equivalent of Chongqing's hotpot bowl or Xiamen's record player: a specific, true, slightly surprising detail about THIS place, not a generic symbol of 'a school.'
delight_element.construction: A stylized diving-block/lane-rope motif, or a trophy on a podium (matching the real 'We Are The CHAMPION' banner's own podium graphic) — large, one object, the way the hotpot bowl or record player is large and singular.

nameplate.shape: Shield-echo shape (a soft nod to the crest's silhouette, without reproducing the crest itself) OR integrated directly into the trophy/podium delight element — matching the pattern of 'nameplate lives ON the delight element or dominant landmark, not floating alone'
nameplate.text_content: La Salle Primary School (English only, per the owner's earlier decision)
nameplate.construction: Layered/die-cut style, matching the reference plaques' physical construction

human_figures.reasoning: Matches the confirmed hard pattern across all 4 references — drop the jumping-student silhouettes entirely, they were never consistent with the house style.

color_palette.sky_treatment: Light blue with soft clouds, matching the reference sky treatment

layering_order_back_to_front: Pool/trophy delight element + integrated nameplate in foreground
